integrity: The complement-group premise is taken from the cited primary source. The cyclic-cover abelianization is proved directly, and every Smith factor through degree \(10\) is recomputed by exact integer minors in the bundled verifier.
scientific_limitations: The result is confined to the explicit \(\ell=0\) pair and cover degrees through \(10\); it does not classify the infinite family or claim optimality among all finite quotients.
title: The tenth cyclic cover first separates a same-Alexander Cappell–Shaneson pair
